nodes.label: Favicon: abstract purple lightning-bolt/arrow logo mark with blurred gradient blobs
nodes.rationale: SVG shows a jagged angular purple (#863bff) path resembling a lightning bolt or stylized arrow/paper-airplane shape, used as a mask over several blurred (feGaussianBlur) purple and light-blue gradient ellipse blobs, producing a soft abstract app-icon logo mark rather than a literal calendar glyph.
